title: 🖐️ Retro Player / Self Hand + Carried Pet

accepted_baseline.label: Persistent low-res first-person scene
preserve: one coherent generated photographic hand identity

current_candidate.summary: V9 separates PLAYER_HAND from FRONT_ACTOR_HANDS, anchors the player's curated hand sequence to the lower-right first-person camera edge, and turns the carried mask/heart relic into a living front-center pet that breathes, bobs and reacts to petting.

open_feedback: Review whether the lower-right hand now unmistakably reads as the player's own hand rather than a hand facing the camera.
Review the carried mask-heart creature as a pet: front-center, living, responsive, but not a giant blocking prop.
If the current INSPECT-derived self sequence still contains a pose that reads as another actor's palm, remove that frame rather than rotating the whole visual language.
Keep FRONT_ACTOR_HANDS as a separate actor category and do not silently mix those frames back into PLAYER_HAND.
Judge the petting motion and pet recoil in the published scene; tune only after real visual feedback.
